_metadata.description: Contains ATTACK events and verdicts from the Rust simulation engine. Each attack type has its own correlation_id for independent chain analysis. run_id groups the entire simulation run. DEFENSE events (STRIKE_RECORDED, IP_BANNED) are stored in the backend AuditLog database and available via GET /api/v1/audit/events/defense. Use scripts/neo4j_ingest.js to merge both for Neo4j ingestion.
